title: Sparkly snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE04D'>
    <polygon points='18,15 20,21 26,23 20,25 18,31 16,25 10,23 16,21'/>
    <polygon points='82,20 84,26 90,28 84,30 82,36 80,30 74,28 80,26'/>
    <polygon points='12,55 13,59 17,60 13,61 12,65 11,61 7,60 11,59'/>
    <polygon points='88,58 89,62 93,63 89,64 88,68 87,64 83,63 87,62'/>
    <polygon points='22,78 23,82 27,83 23,84 22,88 21,84 17,83 21,82'/>
    <polygon points='78,80 79,84 83,85 79,86 78,90 77,86 73,85 77,84'/>
    <polygon points='50,8 51,12 55,13 51,14 50,18 49,14 45,13 49,12'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Snowman body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='20' fill='#E8F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#C5E0F5' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Middle section -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15' fill='#F0F8FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#C5E0F5' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='11' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#D0E5F5' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Hat -->
  <rect x='38' y='22' width='24' height='3' rx='1' fill='#4455AA'/>
  <rect x='41' y='10' width='18' height='13' rx='2' fill='#5566CC'/>
  <rect x='41' y='18' width='18' height='3' fill='#FFE04D'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#334466'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#334466'/>

  <!-- Carrot nose -->
  <polygon points='51,35 55,37 51,39' fill='#FF8833'/>

  <!-- Mouth (dots) -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='41' r='1' fill='#5566AA'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='42.5' r='1' fill='#5566AA'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='42.5' r='1' fill='#5566AA'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='41' r='1' fill='#5566AA'/>

  <!-- Scarf -->
  <rect x='39' y='43' width='22' height='4' rx='2' fill='#EE4466'/>
  <polygon points='60,45 63,50 66,48 64,44' fill='#DD3355'/>
  <polygon points='60,45 62,49 64,47 62,44' fill='#EE5577'/>

  <!-- Buttons on body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='1.8' fill='#4455AA'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='64' r='1.8' fill='#4455AA'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='71' r='1.8' fill='#4455AA'/>

  <!-- Stick arms -->
  <line x1='35' y1='50' x2='22' y2='42' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='42' x2='20' y2='38' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='42' x2='22' y2='47' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='65' y1='50' x2='78' y2='42' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='42' x2='80' y2='38' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='42' x2='74' y2='47' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Snow ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='35' ry='5' fill='#D8EDFF'/>
</svg>
